notes.title: Stay at Home Sale!!!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!!!

     To encourage people to stay at home and to help them occupy their time, we are putting [b]Caveman The Game[/b] on sale this week.  60% OFF!!!  This sale will end 4/20, so get it for a good price while you can.
     We also wish you all good health and we want to remind you to stay at home and to use good hygiene.  If we all do our part, we can overcome this pandemic!

notes.title: Caveman The Game Release Day!
notes.notes: Today is the day that the Caveman makes his big debut!  We have been waiting and are excited for you to play this adventure filled game.  We are sure that you will have lots of fun helping the Caveman on his mission to rescue his love.
